name: Little Tree | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Red Razz
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Live Resin

Our Red Razz Live Resin Gummies are infused with 20MG of terpene-rich live resin for a balanced, euphoric effect. The tart raspberry flavor is bright and clean, with a smooth finish that keeps you coming back.

With consistent texture and elevated effects, this gummy is a go-to for laid-back days and spontaneous adventures.

Whether you’re walking downtown or unwinding in nature—this gummy brings the flavor and the feeling.
